explanation: The design document calls AMOS-MM an extension of AMOS22 (p. 2). 228 of its CT files (152 training and 76 validation, all named amos_0xxx) are AMOS22 labelled CT images: their size and CRC32 match amos22.zip. AMOS22 has organ masks for these scans; AMOS-MM itself releases none. The other CT files are not AMOS22 images, although most reuse AMOS22 file names (see the quality findings).

evidence.locator: Design document p. 2; size and CRC32 of every member of imagesTr.zip and imagesVa.zip compared with the amos22.zip and unlabelled-data listings
